The Missing Piece#000.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.

The Missing Piece#001.src: Now, how to get up from here...

The Missing Piece#002.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...

The Missing Piece#003.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#003.dst: 흠... 보낸 사람이 없네... 전부 같은 사람이 보낸 건가?

The Missing Piece#004.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#006.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#006.dst: 바쁜 거 안 보여!? 번호표 뽑고 원래 하던 대로 줄 서! 여기 아무도 없든 말든 상관없어, 절차대로 해!
The Missing Piece#006.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#007.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: 매달린 들보를 길처럼 배열하면 이 틈을 건널 수 있겠다.

The Missing Piece#008.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#008.dst: 아, 맞다! 편지들. 내 정신 좀 봐, 하마터면 잊을 뻔했네.

The Missing Piece#010.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#011.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#011.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#012.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#015.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#015.dst: 금방 갈게! 어휴, 요즘 사람들은 참을성이 없어...
The Missing Piece#015.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#016.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#016.dst: 벌써 기다리기 지쳤어? 누가 내가 돌아올 때 맞춰 여길 난장판으로 만들어 놨거든!
The Missing Piece#016.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#017.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#017.dst: 어제 그럴 만한 자격이 있는, 짧은, 18주짜리 휴가에서 돌아왔어. 그런데 이게 그 보답이야?!
The Missing Piece#017.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#018.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: 대리가 여길 어떻게 해 놨는지 보여? 이제 내가 치워야 해. 안 그러면 왕실 감찰관이 내 목을 칠 거라고!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: 알아 둬, 난 Aelumia 왕립 대학을 우등으로 졸업했어.
The Missing Piece#019.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#020.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#020.dst: 솔직히 날 이런 데에... 으... 촌뜨기들이랑 처박아 둔 건 모욕이야! 아, 냄새 얘기는 꺼내지도 마!
The Missing Piece#020.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#021.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#021.dst: 아무튼 그건 중요한 게 아니고. 뭘 원한다고 했지?
The Missing Piece#021.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#022.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#022.dst: 너구나! 내 휴가 동안 여길 맡겼던 게 바로 너야, 이 악당아!
The Missing Piece#022.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#023.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: 그럴 줄 알았어! 나 같은 대학 졸업생이 틀릴 리가 없지!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#024.dst: 빠져나갈 생각 마! 나 같은 대학 졸업생이 틀릴 리가 없어!
The Missing Piece#024.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#027.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#027.dst: 감찰이 오면 곤란해지는 건 나만이 아니야, 그건 알겠지?
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#029.dst: 네가 벌여 놓은 이 난장판을 수습하면... 무슨 일이 있었는지 아무도 모르게 되는 거지.
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: 넌 곤란해질 일 없고, 왕실 감찰관도 만족, 나도 만족. 다들 행복하지!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#033.dst: 그럼 목숨 걸린 것처럼 우편물을 분류하게 해 주지, 이 악당아!
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#037.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#037.dst: 분류는 너무 쉬워서 너 같은 놈도 할 수 있을 거야.
The Missing Piece#037.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#038.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#038.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#039.dst: 저기 가야 할 자리에 두기만 하면 돼.
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#040.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#040.dst: {p} 소포는 {p}에, Auburn 소포는 {p}에, 뭐 그런 식이지.
The Missing Piece#040.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#046.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#046.dst: 뭐, 그건 몸풀기일 뿐이야! 더 남았으니까 벌써 게으름 피우지 마!
The Missing Piece#046.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#047.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#047.dst: 흠... 이번엔 괜찮았지만 조심해, 마지막 소포들은 빨리 오거든!
The Missing Piece#047.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#048.dst: 소포 몇 개 분류했다고 대단한 사람인 줄 알지 마!
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#049.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#050.dst: 으악! 다시 해, 이번엔 제대로 하는 게 좋을 거야!
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#051.dst: 으악! 다시 해, 이번엔 제대로 하는 게 좋을 거야!
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#052.dst: 일하는 중엔 귀찮게 하지 마! 너 같은 놈들이랑 빈둥대려고 대학 간 거 아니거든!
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#055.dst: 잠깐, 그럼 이건 뭐야? 왜 {p}로 가는 소포가 이렇게 많아?
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#056.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#056.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: 이 소포들 뭐야! 편지로 가득 차 있잖아?
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: 흥... 전부 언덕 위의 여인에게라니... 대체 무슨 뜻인지!
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: 어이, 악당. 이것도 네 일이야, 알지!
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#060.dst: 이 편지들 배달해! 안 그러면... 안 그러면 네가 한 짓을 왕실 감찰관한테 이를 거야! 그래, 나 건드리지 마!
The Missing Piece#060.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#061.dst: 내가 어떻게 알아! 알아내는 건 네 일이지. 봐, 여기 '언덕 위의 여인에게'라고 써 있잖아, 그거면 충분하지 않아?
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: 아, 건드릴 수 있지! 난 아주 높은 자리에 친구가 아주 많아! 대학에서 만났지, 꼭 기억해 둬!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#063.dst: 좋아! 이제 그 일은 정리됐으니 드디어 내 아주 중요한 일로 돌아갈 수 있겠군.
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#064.dst: 아, 그래. 아주 중요하지. 대학 졸업생이라고, 말했던가?
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: 자자, 어서 가. 그 수수께끼의 여인을 못 찾았다고 울면서 돌아오지 말고!
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#066.dst: 편지를 잃어버리면 언제든 또 줄 수 있어, 어차피 거의 끝도 없이 있는 것 같으니까!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#067.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 근처에서 언덕 위의 여인에 대해 알아보세요.

The Missing Piece#068.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#068.dst: 게으름 피우려고? 아직 편지 갖고 있잖아, 가서 배달해!
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#071.dst: 이걸로 빠져나갈 생각 마! 여분이 있거든!
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: 자, 가서 이 일 좀 처리해 줄래? 네가 허둥대지 않아도 신경 쓸 게 충분히 많거든!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#074.dst: 사람을 찾는다고? 이 근방에서 그런 짓 하는 건 보통 깡통들이지.
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#075.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: 그놈들 방문 한 번이면 왕실 부담으로 휴가를 공짜로 떠나게 돼, 무슨 말인지 알지?
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#076.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#076.dst: 뭐, 찾는 게 Lars라면 기꺼이 꼰질러 주겠지만, 누군지 아직 말 안 했잖아.
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#077.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: 이 근방엔 언덕도 많고 여자도 많지. 근데 내가 알기로 다들 공장에서 뼈 빠지게 일하지, 언덕 위엔 없어.
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#078.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#078.dst: 미안하다 친구, 그건 못 도와줄 것 같네. Lars한테 물어봐, 보통 내 뒤 골목에서 모닥불을 독차지하고 있어. 재수 없는 놈...
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#080.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#080.dst: 다 말해 줬잖아, 안 그래? Lars나 가서 괴롭혀, 더 할 말 없어.
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#082.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#082.dst: '언덕 위의 여인'이라는 사람을 찾고 있어. 그 사람한테 전해야 할 편지가 있거든.
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#083.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#083.dst: 편지? 언덕 위 여자는 하나도 모르겠는데, 저기 Bush라면 알지도 몰라.
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#084.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#084.dst: 걘 보통 이것저것 알아... 아는 놈이야.
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#085.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#085.dst: 그래도 너무 오래 얘기하진 마, 머릿속에 이상한 생각을 집어넣기 시작하니까...
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#087.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#088.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#088.dst: 난 Bush, 반가워요. 뭔가 알고 싶은 게 있나요?
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#089.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#089.dst: 아, 그래요, 그녀... 이 Bush는 그녀를 너무 잘 알죠!
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#090.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#090.dst: 그녀가 없으면 이 Bush는 시들어요! 그래요, 덤불이 자라려면 물이 필요하죠. 알아요, 알아요!
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#091.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#091.dst: 하지만 먼저, 당신이 왜 알아야 하는지 알아야 해요! 알아요?
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#092.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#092.dst: 편지! 이 Bush가 내용을 알 수만 있다면... 아아, 알면 실례겠죠...
The Missing Piece#092.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#093.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#093.dst: 편지 배달부라, 참으로 고귀한 직업이에요. 그녀가 있는 곳을 알려 줄게요. 대신 그녀에게 꼭 전해요: 친구가 마을에 돌아왔다고.
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#094.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#094.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#095.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#096.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#096.dst: 왜 알아야 하는지 아냐고요? 나도 몰라요... 아는 건 알아야 한다는 것뿐!
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#097.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#097.dst: 다시, 왜 알아야 하는지 말해 봐요.
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#098.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#098.dst: 아무것도 없다고요? 그런 사람이 있는 줄은 몰랐어요! 이제 알았어요, 이제 알았어요!
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#100.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#102.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#102.dst: 우편물? 집을 잘못 찾아온 것 같구나.
The Missing Piece#102.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#103.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#103.dst: 나한테 그런 걸 보낼 사람은 없는데...
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#104.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#105.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#107.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#107.dst: 언덕 위엔 손님이 많이 오지 않거든.
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#112.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#115.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#116.dst: 자, 앉으렴. 마실 것 좀 만들어 줄게.
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#118.dst: 이 근방 사람처럼은 안 보이는구나, 그렇지?
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#119.dst: 응? 뭐, 손님 비밀을 캐면 안 되겠지. 설명 못 할 일은 그냥 두는 게 낫지, 하. 안 그러니?
The Missing Piece#119.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#120.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#120.dst: 여기 Roughworks에선 비밀이 없어. 적어도 여왕 폐하는 그렇게 믿고 싶어 하시지, 하.
The Missing Piece#120.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#121.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#121.dst: 그래서 여기 살기로 했어. 동네에선 벽이 종이보다 얇거든. 안 들리는 게 없어.
The Missing Piece#121.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#122.dst: 여기 언덕 위는 훨씬 평화로워. 수도국만 문을 두드리지 않는다면, 하.
The Missing Piece#122.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#123.dst: 뭐, 이왕 왔으니 잠깐 얘기나 할까? 여기선 말할 상대가 별로 없거든!
The Missing Piece#123.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#124.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#125.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#125.dst: 물뿌리개는 바로 밖 정원에 있어. 화분이 안에 셋, 밖에 셋 있단다.
The Missing Piece#125.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#126.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#126.dst: Elise가 편지를 읽는 동안 식물에 물을 주세요.

The Missing Piece#128.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: 아, 엉망이구나... 이걸 이해하려니 머리가 아프네.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#129.dst: 이렇게 많은 편지가, 이렇게 오랜 세월 동안... 대체 누가 이토록 끈질기게 날 찾으려는 걸까?
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#130.dst: 응? 아, 벌써 물 다 줬니? 빠르구나!
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#131.dst: 뭐, 이래서는 진전이 없겠어. 우리 둘 다 좀 쉬어야 할 것 같구나.
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#132.dst: 아, 오늘 날씨 참 좋네... 밖에 나가서 잠깐 정원을 즐기는 게 어떠니?
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#135.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#136.dst: 아... 막 물을 준 꽃들. 이 향기만 한 게 없지.
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#137.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#137.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#138.dst: Roughworks 전체에서 저런 나무는 저거 하나뿐이야. 아름답지 않니?
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#139.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#140.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#140.dst: 답답해, 너무 답답해... 그 소중한 기억들이...
The Missing Piece#140.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.

The Missing Piece#143.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#146.dst: 아, 그런 뜻이 아닌 거 알잖아.

The Missing Piece#147.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#147.dst: 한 해가 지날 때마다... 이 나무는 더 크고, 더욱 아름다워질 거야.

The Missing Piece#148.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#148.dst: 수많은 폭풍을 견뎌야 하고, 어떤 날은 물 없이 버텨야 할지도 몰라. 그래도 계속 자랄 거야.

The Missing Piece#150.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#150.dst: 그리고 10년, 15년, 어쩌면 25년 뒤엔... 마침내 그 그늘에서 쉴 수 있겠지.

The Missing Piece#151.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#152.dst: 아, 알았다! 나무 그늘 아래서 소풍을 하면 되겠다. 좋지 않아, {u}?
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#153.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#153.dst: ... 좋아. 정말 좋겠다, Elise. 그럴 수 있을지도.

The Missing Piece#154.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#154.dst: 어서, 물 좀 더 줘. 안 그러면 한 치도 안 자랄 거야!

The Missing Piece#159.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: 그냥 생각했어... 내가 언젠가 죽으면, 여기 이 나무 아래에 묻히고 싶어.

The Missing Piece#160.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#160.dst: 응? 왜 그런 바보 같은 생각을 해? 우린 아직 살날이 한참 남았잖아, 안 그래?
The Missing Piece#160.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#161.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#161.dst: 물론, 네 말이 맞아. 미안, 아직 익숙하지 않아서...

The Missing Piece#164.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#164.dst: 잠깐 햇볕이나 즐기자. 내일도 일해야 하니까.
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#167.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#167.dst: 흠. 걱정은 다른 날로 미뤄야겠구나. 오늘은 좋은 날이야... 걱정할 날이 아니지.
The Missing Piece#167.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#168.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#168.dst: 사실, 오늘은 그냥 보내기엔... 어디도 안 가고 보내기엔 너무 좋은 날이야. 안 그러니?
The Missing Piece#168.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#170.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#171.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#171.dst: 아... 저쪽 공장 보이니? 젊었을 때 저기서 일했었지...
The Missing Piece#171.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#172.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#172.dst: 윗동네에 보낼 빵을 대량으로 만들었어... 지루하고, 알아주는 이도 없는 일이었지.
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#173.dst: 알아챘겠지만, 이 근방 사정이 그리 넉넉하지 않아. 힘들 땐 도둑질까지 하는 사람도 있지...
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#174.dst: 다행히... 난 그럴 필요가 없었어. 가끔 조금씩 집에 가져가게 해 줬거든.
The Missing Piece#174.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#175.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#175.dst: 좋은 시절이었지. 그럴 때면 소풍을 가곤 했어, 나랑- 흠. 나 혼자였겠지.
The Missing Piece#175.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#176.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#176.dst: 구하기가 너무 어려워서 아쉬워... 도둑질이 정말 큰 문제가 됐거든. 결국 왕실이 전부 안전하게 보관하려고 공장 지하에 금고를 지었어!
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#177.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#177.dst: 마지막으로 먹은 게 언제더라? 분명 몇 년은 됐지... 그 빵이 우리 같은 가난뱅이한테 올 리가 없지, 하!
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#178.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#178.dst: 그래도 다시 먹어 보면 좋겠구나... 옛날 생각도 하고.
The Missing Piece#178.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#179.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#179.dst: 뭐, 이왕 내 심부름을 하는 김에... 빵 한두 덩이 구해 볼 수 있겠니?
The Missing Piece#179.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#180.dst: 비싸긴 해도 값만 맞으면... 분명 구할 수 있을 거야. 그런 일로 애먹을 사람 같진 않은데, 그렇지, 배달부 양반?
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#181.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#181.dst: 하! 뭐, 어쨌든 힘내렴. 돌아오면 오늘 뭘 할지 계획이 있어. 어떠니?
The Missing Piece#181.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#183.dst: 아, 이런... 당신은 알아요! 알아요! 먼저 저 치안대원과 얘기해요, 그러면 더 알려 줄지도 몰라요.
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#184.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: 구걸하러 왔다면 그냥 돌아가는 게 좋을 거다.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#185.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#187.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: 내가 자판기로 보이나? 딴 데 가 봐. 여긴 빵을 만들기만 하지, 팔진 않아.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#188.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#188.dst: 가라, 친구. 치안대원이 지켜보는 데서 어슬렁거리면 안 되지.
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#189.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#189.dst: 하지만, 하지만, 하지만! 하지만은 없어. 내가 뭘 하게 만들지 마! 서류 작업은 늘 골치 아프거든...
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#191.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: 당연히 안 되지... 안 그래도 골치 아픈데, 지난주엔 통 하나를 도둑맞고... 생산 할당량까지...
The Missing Piece#191.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#192.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#194.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#196.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#196.dst: 알아요? 알아요? 어떤 건물이든 들어가는 길은 하나가 아니에요.
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#197.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#197.dst: 알려 줄게요! 하지만 도둑질은 비윤리적이에요, 알아 둬요!
The Missing Piece#197.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#198.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#198.dst: 그녀만 모르면 돼요! 그녀는 모를 거예요! 이해했어요?
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#199.dst: 바로 모퉁이 돌면 있어요. 파이프! 이제 알았죠! 이제 알았죠!
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#200.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#201.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#201.dst: 바로 모퉁이 돌면 있어요. 파이프! 이제 알았죠! 이제 알았죠!
The Missing Piece#201.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#203.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#203.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 승강기로 빵 금고에 들어갈 방법을 찾으세요.

The Missing Piece#206.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#206.dst: 어? 그게 대답이야! 자, 누군지 말해, 안 그러면 내가 직접 보러 간다! 난 얼굴은 절대 안 잊어, 명심해!
The Missing Piece#206.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#207.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#207.dst: 인부가 왜 내 사무실에 있어!? 자, 누군지 말해, 안 그러면 내가 직접 보러 간다! 난 얼굴은 절대 안 잊어, 명심해!
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#209.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#209.dst: 그래, 알려 줘서 고맙군! 당장 조사하겠어!
The Missing Piece#209.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#211.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#213.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.

The Missing Piece#214.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#215.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#217.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#217.dst: ...그리고 우리 규정에 따라, 이 전 직원의 상세 기록이 필요하오. 근속 연수, 알려진 연고자, 근무 실적... 전부 다.
The Missing Piece#217.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#218.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#218.dst: 물론 힘닿는 데까지 협조하겠습니다, 폐하께 축복을. 하지만 상자 하나 도난당한 일이 이렇게 높은 곳까지 올라갈 줄은...
The Missing Piece#218.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#219.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#219.dst: 상자는 중요하지 않소. 관심 대상은 그 직원이오. 추가 조치가 필요할 수도 있지만, 우선 기록부터 보면 되오.
The Missing Piece#219.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#220.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#220.dst: ...그 직원만요? 질문을 용서하십시오만, 그녀가 왜 관심 대상인지 모르겠습니다.
The Missing Piece#220.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#221.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#221.dst: 그건 우리가 알 일이고, 당신은 협조만 하면 되오. 다만 우리가 조사 중인 보안 침해 가능성과 관련된 일이오.
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#222.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#222.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#223.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#223.dst: 아무것도 암시하지 않았소. 당신 처지를 일깨워 줘야 하오? 내가 여기 온 건 여왕 폐하의 뜻이오. 정말 거역할 생각이오?
The Missing Piece#223.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#224.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#224.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#226.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#226.dst: 예, 예, 물론이죠. 하지만 그 일은 몇 년 전에 끝난 줄 알았는데! 대체 무슨 관련이-
The Missing Piece#226.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#227.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: 쓸데없는 소리는 그만. 내 시간은 한정돼 있소. 이 Elise란 자의 기록을 당장 가져오시오.
The Missing Piece#227.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#228.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#228.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#375.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#375.dst: 그래도 여기서 보면 다 작아 보여... 그렇지? 이 경치 좀 봐!
The Missing Piece#375.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#376.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#376.dst: 정말 아름답다... 여기 있으면 우리 말고는 아무것도 중요하지 않은 것 같아.

The Missing Piece#377.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#377.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#378.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#379.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#379.dst: 하, 근데 목소리가 왜 그렇게 슬퍼?
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#381.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#381.dst: 아무것도 아니야... 우린 이대로 있을 거야... 영원히. 약속해.

The Missing Piece#382.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#382.dst: 또 그 사람... 누구지? 왜 이런 게 기억나는 걸까?
The Missing Piece#382.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#384.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#384.dst: 뭐, 이제 와서 어쩔 수 없잖니? 그래, 우리 나가 볼까?
The Missing Piece#384.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: 어머나. 말 안 했나? 빵은 소풍 가려고 부탁한 거야!
The Missing Piece#385.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#386.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#386.dst: 딱 좋은 곳을 알아... 사실 네 덕에 떠올랐어. 거기선 Roughworks 전체가 내려다보여, 믿어지니?
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#387.dst: 그런데... 생각해 보니 좀 멀구나... 이 늙은 다리로 거기까지 갈 수 있을지 모르겠네, 하!
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#388.dst: 이 근처에 누군가는 이 암호를 알고 있을 거야...

The Missing Piece#389.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#389.dst: 이제 어떻게든 이곳을 빠져나가기만 하면 된다...

The Missing Piece#390.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#390.dst: 저 병들을 맞히면 들보가 움직일지도 모른다.

The Missing Piece#394.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#394.dst: 그래, 어떻게 할래? 나갈 준비가 되면 말만 하렴.
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#396.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#399.dst: 어머, 여기선 정말 많은 게 보이는구나... 가자!
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#400.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#400.dst: 어디로 가냐고? 딱 맞는 곳을 알지! 어디 보자, 거기가...
The Missing Piece#400.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#401.dst: 흠... 아마... 앞으로! 그래, 여기서 쭉 앞이었던 것 같아. 기억이 좀 흐릿할 수도 있지만...
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#403.dst: 아, 흠... 여기서 왼쪽인 것 같은데...
The Missing Piece#403.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#404.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#404.dst: 아니, 잠깐... 오른쪽이야, 분명 오른쪽으로 돌아야 해!
The Missing Piece#404.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#406.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#406.dst: 저 집 낯이 익은데... 아마... 그래, 여기서 오른쪽!
The Missing Piece#406.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#408.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#408.dst: 멈춰! 흠... 적어도 이 다리 건너편은 아닌 것 같아. 그렇다면...
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#409.dst: 아이, 왜 그러니! 결국엔 찾을 거야, 그렇지? 분명 왼쪽이었어!
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#411.dst: 그래, 여기야! 이 모퉁이만 돌면 돼, 확실해!
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#413.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#413.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#414.dst: 그런데 이렇게 수풀이 우거진 기억은 없는데...
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#415.dst: 얼마나 됐을까? 마지막으로 온 게 언제인지 기억이 안 나...
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#417.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#417.dst: 아, 막혔구나... 흠. 꺼내고 싶지 않았지만, 다른 방법이 없는 것 같네.
The Missing Piece#417.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#418.dst: 아, 이제 시치미 뗄 필요 없어. 네가 뭔지 알아. 너도 그들 중 하나지?
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#419.dst: 저주받은 자, 왕실은 그렇게 부르지. 난 상관없지만!
The Missing Piece#419.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#420.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#420.dst: 내가 왜 신경 써? 난 늙었어! 안 그래도 걱정거리가 많은데...
The Missing Piece#420.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#421.dst: 게다가 이럴 땐 확실히 쓸모 있잖니? 착하지, 네 그 작은 재주 좀 부려 주련?
The Missing Piece#421.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#423.dst: 그래, 그거야... 이제 내려 주렴, 남은 길은 혼자 걸을 수 있어.
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#425.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#425.dst: 기억보다 좀 더... 뭐랄까, 황량하구나. 그래도 괜찮아.
The Missing Piece#425.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#426.dst: 이 승강기로 꼭대기까지 갈 수 있어. 그런데 네가 제어실로 들어갈 방법을 찾아야 해... 그리 어렵진 않을 거야!
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#427.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#427.dst: 저 위에 있는 저거야. 오른쪽 터널로 가면 닿을 수 있어.
The Missing Piece#427.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#431.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#431.dst: 내 말 들리니? 난 여기 아래야!
The Missing Piece#431.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#432.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#432.dst: 조종 장치로 날 올려 줘! 어떻게 쓰는지 알지?
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.

The Missing Piece#436.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#436.dst: 그렇다면... 아, 알았다. 상승 버튼에 뭘 올려놓고, 걸린 걸 치우면... 올라갈 수 있을 거야.
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#437.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#437.dst: 완벽해! 이제 움직일 거야, 걸린 것만 빼낼 수 있다면...
The Missing Piece#437.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#438.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#440.dst: 뭐, 어차피 버려진 곳 같은데! 좀 부순다고 누가 신경 쓰겠어?
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#441.dst: 저기 올라가서 이걸 다시 움직일 방법이 있는지 봐 주렴.
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#443.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#444.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#444.dst: 어떻게 돼 가니? 뭐 좀 보여?
The Missing Piece#444.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#451.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#452.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#452.dst: 아, 여기 참 좋지 않니. 바람도, 경치도, 전부 다.
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#453.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#454.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#454.dst: 그리고 드디어! 앉을 곳이! 이렇게 다사다난한 하루를 보냈으니 좀 쉬어야겠어.
The Missing Piece#454.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#455.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#457.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#457.dst: 흠. 이상하지. 하루 종일... 추억에 잠겨 있었던 것 같아. 그리고 이 경치를 보니... 또 그 그리운 기분이 드는구나.
The Missing Piece#457.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#458.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#458.dst: 하루 종일 이런... 과거의 환영을 봤어. 일어났던 기억이 없는 일들을.
The Missing Piece#458.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#459.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#459.dst: 그리고 난... 솔직히, 어떻게 받아들여야 할지 모르겠어...
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#460.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#460.dst: 하지만 알아- 마음속으론 알아, 뭔가 빠져 있다는 걸... 모든 게 맞춰질 한 조각이.
The Missing Piece#460.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#462.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#462.dst: 꿈마다 그녀가 내 곁에 있어... 그런데 이름도 기억 안 나. 얼굴조차 떠오르지 않아...
The Missing Piece#462.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#463.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#463.dst: 그녀가 그렇게 소중했다면... 어떻게 잊을 수 있지?
The Missing Piece#463.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#466.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#466.dst: 헉... 헉... 잠깐, 숨 좀 돌리고.
The Missing Piece#466.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#467.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#469.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#470.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#470.dst: 배달할 편지를 더 찾아서 가져가던 중에 너희 둘이 뛰쳐나오는 걸 봤어! 내가 얼마나 놀랐는지 알아?
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#471.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#471.dst: 그래서 당연히 따라가기로 했지, 나처럼 훌륭한 우체국장이라면. 근데 정말 쉽지 않더라! 겨우 여기까지 올라왔어... 그나저나 좋은 곳이네.
The Missing Piece#471.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#472.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#473.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#473.dst: 나 같은 대학 졸업생한테 여기 오르는 건 일도 아니죠!
The Missing Piece#473.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#476.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#476.dst: 뭐, 온 용건은 그게 다인 것 같네요. 그럼...
The Missing Piece#476.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#477.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#477.dst: 겨우 그거 하려고 여기까지 왔어요!? 빵이라도 한 조각 드시고 가요...!
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#478.dst: 아뇨, 아뇨. 그럴 순 없죠! 일이 부르니까요, 우편물이 알아서 분류되진 않잖아요... 아, 여왕 폐하시여, 밀린 일이...
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#479.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#479.dst: 맞다! 너! 인정하긴 싫지만, 일은 그럭저럭 잘한 것 같네.
The Missing Piece#479.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#480.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#480.dst: 기록을 다시 확인해 봤는데 내 대리는, 음, 완전히 다른 사람이었던 것 같아!
The Missing Piece#480.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#481.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#481.dst: 피해 없으면 된 거지, 그렇지? 일은 이미 끝났잖아! 무르기 없기! 알았지?
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#483.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#483.dst: 응, 뭐라고? 안 들려! 그래, 잘 가!
The Missing Piece#483.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#485.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#485.dst: 그래도 이 편지를 전해 주다니 친절하구나. 어디 보자.
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#487.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#487.dst: 아, 모르겠어... 그녀가 사과할 게 뭐가 있다는 거지?
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#488.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#488.dst: 제발... {u}, 숨 좀 쉬어. 떨고 있잖아.
The Missing Piece#488.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#490.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: 그런 폭풍에 휘말리다니... 정말, 몇 시간쯤은 기다릴 수 있었어! 무리해서 올 필요 없었다고.
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#492.dst: 그래, 지금 날씨가 나쁜 건 알아... 하지만 결국엔 다시 좋아질 거야. 구름이 걷히고 해가 다시 뜨겠지. 그렇지?
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#494.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#494.dst: 있잖아, 가끔 비 오는 것도 나쁘지 않아. 적어도 꽃에 물은 안 줘도 되잖아! 그리고 비 온 뒤 젖은 풀 냄새만 한 게 없지, 안 그래?
The Missing Piece#494.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#495.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#495.dst: 날이 개면 뭐라도 하자. 오랜만에 왔으니 우리 자리에 가는 건 어때? 먹다 남은 빵도 좀 있을 거야...
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#496.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#496.dst: Elise. 넌- 제발, 용서해 줘- 넌 위험해. 난-

The Missing Piece#497.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#497.dst: 내가 위험하다고? 난 평범한 노동자일 뿐인데, 누가 날 해칠 이유가 있겠어? 난 괜찮을 거야.
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#498.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#498.dst: {u}, 이런 날씨에 무리하는 건 너잖아, 누가 봐도 허둥대고...
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#499.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#499.dst: 요즘은 널 보기도 힘들어. 그런데 갑자기 이런 꼴로 나타나다니... 무슨 일이야? 제발, 말 좀 해 줘.
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#500.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#500.dst: ...하. 난- 난 너한테 솔직하지 않았어, Elise, 그리고- 나중에 설명할게. 여길 떠나야 해, 그들이 오기 전에-

The Missing Piece#501.dst: ...안 돼. 안 돼... 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼...

The Missing Piece#503.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#503.dst: 왜 그들이... 아니, 이건 말이 안 돼...

The Missing Piece#504.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: 흠. 그럼 별일 아닐지도 몰라. 누군지 보고 올게.
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#505.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#505.dst: 하나로는 모자랐나... 이 작은 집에 오겠다고 폭풍을 뚫고 올 만큼 어리석은 사람이 누구람? 무슨 일이든 기다리면 되지.
The Missing Piece#505.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#508.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#508.dst: 안 돼... 안 돼... 당신들 뭘... 왜-
The Missing Piece#508.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#509.dst: 소란을 피워 죄송합니다, 부인. 하지만 처리할 용무가 있어서요.
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#511.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: {u}, {u}, 저 사람들이 왜 여기 있어? 왜... 왜 대답을 안 해...?
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#512.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#512.dst: 무슨 짓을 한 거야? 난... 제발, 설명해 줘... 난- 난...
The Missing Piece#512.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: I... how did I overlook this...?

The Missing Piece#514.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#514.dst: 생각만큼 대단한 전략가는 아니었나 보군, 암사자.
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#516.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...

The Missing Piece#517.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#517.dst: 그러면... 다 괜찮을 거야. 그... 그럴 거야.

The Missing Piece#520.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#520.dst: 그녀가... 무슨 짓을 한 거지? 왜 날 끌어들인 거야?
The Missing Piece#520.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#521.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#521.dst: 기억나는 모든 게... 답보다 질문만 더 늘어나. 왜 그녀가 기억나지 않지...? 왜!?
The Missing Piece#521.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#522.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#522.dst: 난- 난 그냥 평범한 공장 노동자야! 일찍 일어나고, 늦게까지 일하고, 늦게 자고... 다음 날 또 똑같이.
The Missing Piece#522.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#523.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#523.dst: 왕실에 대해 한마디도 한 적 없어! 그들이 대체 왜... 나 따위를...?
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#524.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#524.dst: 그들은... 내게서 모든 걸 앗아 갔어. 젊음도, 몸도, 시간도, 그리고... 난 대가 한 번 바란 적 없는데.
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#525.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#525.dst: 그런데 왜... 왜 이것만은 가질 수 없는 거야? 이 작은 하나를? 왜 그녀를 기억할 수 없지...?
The Missing Piece#525.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#526.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#526.dst: ...아, 슬프게 들릴지도 모르겠지만... 이렇게 전부 돌아보니...
The Missing Piece#526.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#527.dst: 내 인생 별로 대단하지 않았지, 그렇지? 하. 남의 빵을 위해 공장에서 뼈 빠지게 일하고...
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: 그래도 그녀가 느껴져. 비록... 얼굴도, 이름도, 손길도 기억나지 않지만... 여전히 느껴져. 내 마음속에 남아서. 빛나고 있어.
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#529.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#529.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#530.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#530.dst: 내가 바친 걸로는 만족 못 해서... 기억마저 빼앗아야 했던 거야? 그런 거야...?
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#532.dst: 네가 지금 어디 있든... 무슨 일을 했든... 어떤 비밀을 품었든... 그럴 만한 가치가 있었길 바라.
The Missing Piece#532.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#533.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: 이곳을 전부 잿더미로 만들어 주길 바라.
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#535.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#535.dst: 그저 바라는 건... 우리가 더 오래 함께했으면 하는 거야.
The Missing Piece#535.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#536.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#536.dst: 오랫동안 난 내 앞에 깔린 길을 따라갔어. 옳은 일을 했지.

The Missing Piece#537.src: But then... I met you, Elise.

The Missing Piece#538.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#538.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#541.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#541.dst: 보여... 새 한 마리가. 늙고 잿빛인 비둘기야. 날개가 예전처럼 움직이지 않아...
The Missing Piece#541.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#542.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#542.dst: 날고 싶은데, 날 수가 없어... 애쓰고 있어...
The Missing Piece#542.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#544.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#544.dst: 안 돼, 못 하겠어! 너무 슬퍼...
The Missing Piece#544.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#546.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#546.dst: 나무 그늘 아래 앉아서 노래하고 있어. 거의 울음 같은, 애도하는 노래를.
The Missing Piece#546.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#547.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#547.dst: 구름이, 먹구름이 몰려와. 폭풍이 오고 있어. 새가 두리번거리며 필사적으로 찾고 있어. 겁에 질렸어.
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#548.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#548.dst: 그 새가... 뭔가를 부르고 있어... 아니면 누군가를...
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#554.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#554.dst: 안 잊어! 안 잊을 거야! 절대로! 약속했어! 널 절대 잊지 않겠다고 약속했어!
The Missing Piece#554.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#556.dst: 안 돼... 안 돼... 여, 여긴 어디야?
The Missing Piece#556.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#557.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#557.dst: 너는 Roughworks의 평범한 노동자다. 평범한 일을 하고, 평범하지만 외로운 삶을 산다.
The Missing Piece#557.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#559.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#559.dst: 그녀는 네게 아무것도 아니다. 넌 그녀를 만난 적 없다. 앞으로도 만나지 못한다.
The Missing Piece#559.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#562.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#562.dst: 넌 그녀에게 아무것도 아니다! 그녀도 네게 아무것도 아니다! 곧 그녀가 존재했다는 것조차 잊을 것이다.
The Missing Piece#562.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#563.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#563.dst: 아니, 절대 안 잊어! 그녀는 내 전부였어! 지금도 내 전부야! 절대 잊지 않을 거야!
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#564.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#564.dst: 그녀는 네게 아무것도 아니다. 넌 그녀를 만난 적 없다. 앞으로도 만나지 못한다.
The Missing Piece#564.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#565.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: 넌 그녀의 얼굴도, 목소리도, 손길도 모른다.
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#567.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#567.dst: 그녀는 네게 아무것도 아니다. 넌 그녀를 만난 적 없다. 앞으로도 만나지 못한다. 넌 늘 평범했고, 앞으로도 평범할 것이다.
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#570.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#570.dst: 한 번 더 묻겠다. 지시를 이해했나?
The Missing Piece#570.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#581.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#581.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#584.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#584.dst: 다리가... 이상해... 아무래도... 좀 쉬어야 할 것 같아. 길고, 긴 휴식을... 그 정도는 받아도 되겠지... 그렇지?
The Missing Piece#584.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#585.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#585.dst: 날 집에 데려다줄 거지...? 한 번만이라도 더 보고 싶어... 그 나무를.
The Missing Piece#585.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#589.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#589.dst: 정말 크게 자랐구나... 그리고 정말 아름다워. 그렇지, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#589.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#590.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#590.dst: 네가... 네가 이걸... 이렇게 볼 수만... 있었다면...
The Missing Piece#590.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#593.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#593.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Elise의 집 주변 꽃을 조금 꺾으세요.

The Missing Piece#000~1.src: It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.

The Missing Piece#003~1.src: I have some letters that are addressed to you.
The Missing Piece#003~1.dst: 당신 앞으로 온 편지가 몇 통 있어요.

The Missing Piece#004~1.src: Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
The Missing Piece#004~1.dst: 방향 버튼으로 선택한 들보를 움직이고 회전하세요.

The Missing Piece#005~1.src: You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
The Missing Piece#005~1.dst: 그들과 맞서거나, Elise와 어떻게 할지 이야기해 볼 수 있다.

The Missing Piece#007~1.src: It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
The Missing Piece#007~1.dst: 빵을 챙겨서 이곳을 서둘러 빠져나가는 게 좋겠다.

The Missing Piece#008~1.src: You are already carrying a bottle.

The Missing Piece#009~1.src: The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
The Missing Piece#009~1.dst: 낯익은 필체 같다. 하지만, 별 내용은 없다...

The Missing Piece#010~1.src: Throw a Bottle by  RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then  RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
The Missing Piece#010~1.dst: 병을 던지려면  우클릭으로 조준한 뒤  다시 우클릭하세요.

The Missing Piece#189~1.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
The Missing Piece#189~1.dst: 구하기가 너무 어려워서 아쉬워... 도둑질이 정말 큰 문제가 됐거든. 결국 왕실이 전부 안전하게 보관하려고 공장 지하에 금고를 지었어.
The Missing Piece#189~1.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#190~1.src: The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
The Missing Piece#190~1.dst: 문이 잠겨 있다. 앞에 쪽지가 붙어 있다.

The Missing Piece#191~1.src: Now to find a way inside without being caught...
The Missing Piece#191~1.dst: 이제 들키지 않고 안으로 들어갈 방법을 찾아야 한다...

The Missing Piece#476~1.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#476~1.dst: 줄 맨 앞자리로 가는 게 좋겠다.
